target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md, slot 1 (part of the bearer): margin of the bearer + low brightness (PATO_0000327)
reason: The darkness is in the margin, not the whole phyllary or ligule: a colour value (PATO low brightness, synonym 'dark') on the margin as part of the bearer. 'not dark-margined' is its negation.
'petioles/branchlets graceful' means thin and long for their kind; PATO slender has 'gracile' as a RELATED synonym. For a whole plant the word is close to vague, so confidence is limited.
'sub-' means nearly the named value; pattern 01 takes the whole word as the cue. French 'subovale' is read the same way.
Somewhat inflated (bladdery) sheaths, calyces and corollas; 'sub-' is the approximate-value qualifier on PATO inflated.
French 'caduc' is the ordinary word for falling off (deciduous and caducous). The 2026-11-08 EQ review already accepted 'style deciduous (generic)'.
French/English 'minuscule' = very small; PATO decreased size has the RELATED synonym 'small'.
French form of cyathiform, mapped to PATO cup-shaped in the previous review (rule C309).
Bucciniform = shaped like a trumpet (the spurred lower sepal of Impatiens); 'narrowly/broadly' are degree modifiers.

label: stolon-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a stolon: a slender stem with long internodes growing horizontally along or just below the ground surface. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002457 leaf-like and FLOPO bract-like, worded as they are; FLOPO:0991009 creeping covers growth along the ground but not the slender, long-internoded form.
reason: Stems and rhizomes 'stolonlike' are described by resemblance to a stolon; that is not the same as having stolons (stoloniferous = stolon present). It follows the earlier '-like' classes.

label: stipule-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a stipule. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0002459 sepal-like and FLOPO bract-like, worded as they are.
reason: Leaflets (pseudostipules), bracts and basal projections 'stipulelike' look like stipules but are not stipules; there is no PATO term, and the parallel sepal-like and bract-like classes exist.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values): obovoid (FLOPO:0991025) to oblong (PATO_0000946)
reason: A compound of two shape values (with the transcription spelling 'obvoid'), modelled as a transition between them, not as a new term.

label: semihastate
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flat and having a single approximately triangular basal lobe directed outward on one side of the main axis only. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0104352 hastate, which has two basal lobes; not a kind of hastate.
reason: A precise stipule and wing shape (one-sided hastate) in the Fabaceae. 'semi-' means half, not 'nearly', so the approximate-value pattern does not fit. It is rare, so confidence is limited.
Pinnately cleft = cut pinnately into lobes with the incisions not reaching the midrib, which is the definition of FLOPO pinnatifid.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values): linear (PATO_0001199) to rhomboid (PATO_0001938)
reason: A compound of two shape values for moss laminal cells, represented as a transition between them.

target: limbidium present (no PO or FLOPO class yet: a leaf margin border (part of PO_0020128) of elongate, thick-walled cells needs a FLOPO anatomy class)

A chemical spot-test result (KOH, lichen reagents), meaningless without the reagent and not a morphological quality of the part.
PATO subspherical is 'nearly, but not perfectly, spherical', so no pattern is needed.

target: the bearer itself absent, e.g. pedicel (PO_0030112) absent, petiolule (PO_0020050) absent
reason: French 'nul' ('pédicelle nul', 'androphore nul') states that the named part is lacking: complement of has_part some <bearer>. 'subnul' and 'presque nul' take the approximate-value qualifier.
'without auricles' on grass blades and culm sheaths is the absence of the leaf sheath auricle. Petal auricles have no PO class and stay ungrounded.

label: self-compatible
definition: A compatible quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its being able to form viable seed after fertilization by its own pollen. NOTE: Botany-specific breeding-system quality; with FLOPO:0991137 heterostylous and the sex qualities. 'self-incompatible' would be its sibling under PATO:0000345 incompatible.
reason: A real breeding-system quality of the whole plant with no PATO term; PATO compatible is the general compatibility value it specializes.
Matlike plants grow low and spread into a dense mat, which is the definition of FLOPO mat-forming.
Hirtellous is a kind of pubescence and some hairs are gland-tipped, so FLOPO glandular-pubescent applies as the broader term (as 'prominulous' was mapped to prominent).
Univeined = '1-veined', a count of veins. It splits like 'N-veined' into has number of (PATO:0001555) of vein.
FLOPO caespitose has the synonym 'tufted' and means shoots growing close together in a dense tuft.
Same reading as 'inequilateral' (rule C236): leaf bases and leaflets whose two sides differ are asymmetrical.
It is the absence of an 'appendage', which was rejected as a generic part without an organ, so there is nothing to ground the absence on.

target: new: indumentum with hair colour (puberulous (FLOPO:0991049) on the bearer + ferruginous colour, FLOPO:0988002 orange RELATED synonym, on its trichomes (PO_0000282))
reason: A compound of two values on different bearers: the part is puberulous and its hairs are rust-coloured. It needs a hair-colour pattern, not one term.

label: lithophytic
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing on rock surfaces or in rock crevices rather than in soil. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives); kept in FLOPO beside FLOPO:0991110 epiphytic and FLOPO:0991111 terrestrial. The existing phenotype FLOPO_0980082 'whole plant litophytic' should become whole plant + this value.
reason: A habitat/life-form quality parallel to epiphytic and terrestrial (both added in batch 1). No value class exists, only the precomposed FLOPO_0980082.
